I re-derived the two-token distance chain. Its rates match Solution 3's table, and the boundary and bulk equations reproduce Solution 2's recurrence. The bound state of the chain is normalizable only when $|z| < (d-1)^{-1/2}$, and it crosses the band edge exactly when $\sqrt{d-1}=3$, i.e. $d=10$. At $d=9$, Solution 3's eigenfunction $(1/2)^k$ fails this condition because $(d-1)z^2 = 2 > 1$, so it is not in $\ell^2$. Solution 1's heuristic (weight-1/2 splitting with a Kesten–Stigum-type threshold) does not correspond to the actual dynamics. My confidence is limited by not having checked the literature value directly.
